Bunsen-Burner.title: Bunsen Burner
Bunsen-Burner.tagline: Arrange, act and assert, enforced by the compiler.
Bunsen-Burner.description: A test DSL for C# that turns arrange-act-assert into a composable pipeline, and disposes everything the arrange and act stages create.

Cutout.title: Cutout
Cutout.tagline: Templating that costs nothing at runtime.
Cutout.description: A source generator that renders Liquid style templates into a StringBuilder at compile time, so generated code keeps its indentation without a template engine dependency.

Eon.title: Eon
Eon.tagline: Say when something should run, as data.
Eon.description: A Schedule is a stream of durations. Compose it, iterate it, await it, and never start a thread.

Http-BuildR.title: Http BuildR
Http-BuildR.tagline: Requests and responses, standard library only.
Http-BuildR.description: A fluent builder for HttpRequestMessage and HttpResponseMessage built on System.Net.Http alone, with no dependencies and no wrapper types.

packageReadmes.description: Extension methods that build an HttpRequestMessage out of a chain, using nothing but System.Net.Http.
packageReadmes.title: Http BuildR Request

packageReadmes.description: Extension methods that build a HttpResponseMessage out of a chain, using nothing but System.Net.Http. The usual place for this is a test that needs an expected response.
packageReadmes.title: Http BuildR Response

Icicle.title: Icicle
Icicle.tagline: Freeze a group of tasks into one unit of work.
Icicle.description: A TaskScope groups related child tasks, runs them together, and returns a ResultHandle for each promised value.

Pasted.title: Pasted
Pasted.tagline: Text files, baked into the binary.
Pasted.description: A source generator that turns text files into string constants at compile time, for source generators and AOT binaries that have no assembly directory to read from at runtime.

Polyglot.Notebook.Docfx.Plugin.title: Polyglot Notebook docfx Plugin
Polyglot.Notebook.Docfx.Plugin.description: Renders Polyglot Notebook cells as docfx pages, supporting everything docfx markdown supports, and letting you hide setup cells from the output.

Tuxedo.title: Tuxedo
Tuxedo.tagline: Types that already know they are valid.
Tuxedo.description: A source generator that turns a predicate into a refined type, so a value of that type has already passed the check.

docfx.result-snippets.title: Docfx Result Snippets
docfx.result-snippets.description: Saves the output of a method call to markdown, which a docfx page can include as a table, chart, class diagram or plain snippet.

Quacker.title: Quacker
Quacker.tagline: Duck typing, resolved at compile time.
Quacker.description: A source generator that specialises a generic method for every combination of argument types it is called with, so a member can be invoked on a type parameter the compiler never had to know about.
